cases.fix: Write the complete statement form named by the diagnostic.
Run `jet build app.jet` and rerun the command.

cases.why: The interpreter does not cover this native operation.
cases.fix: Run `jet build app.jet` for the full compiler.

cases.what: The interpreter stopped at this feature.
cases.why: The native evaluator does not cover this operation.
cases.fix: Run `jet build app.jet` for the full compiler.

cases.what: Toolchain channel `0.9` is pinned but not locked.
cases.why: An `--offline`/CI build will not resolve a channel; it needs the exact toolchain version recorded in `.jet/lock`, and none is present. A `jet build` run reports this toolchain error.
cases.fix: Run `jet update jet` to resolve `0.9` to an exact version, then commit `.jet/lock`.

cases.what: The generic cost projection is incomplete.
cases.why: Jet needs valid command input before it can run this command.
cases.fix: Correct the named argument or input, then run the command again.

cases.why: A `jet build` or `jet run` run reports this target-support diagnostic.
cases.fix: Run `jet self doctor --target=<triple>` to see what is missing, or `rustup target add <triple>` to install it.

cases.what: Interpolation uses a value without a Display implementation.
cases.why: The value has Debug but not Display.

cases.what: A repeated representation fallback occurs inside a loop.
cases.why: A growing value can make the repeated copy cost super-linear.
cases.fix: Insert `{fix}` before the highlighted expression to make the copy explicit.
